facts.text: Hotel Des Indes is located on the Lange Voorhout in The Hague.
facts.excerpt: is located at one of the most beautiful spots in Royal The Hague, on the leafy Lange Voorhout

facts.text: The Binnenhof, Noordeinde Palace, the Mauritshuis, Museum Escher in het Paleis and Panorama Mesdag are all close to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Binnenhof with the Hofvijver, Noordeinde Palace, the Lower House, the Mauritshuis, Museum Escher in het Paleis, and Panorama Mesdag are all just a stone's throw away.

facts.text: The restaurant's chandeliers, draperies and seating recall the era when Des Indes was a town palace where heads of state were entertained.
facts.excerpt: The chandeliers, draperies and comfortable seats in the Restaurant are a living monument to the era that Des Indes was a town palace, where heads of state were entertained.

facts.text: High Tea is served daily in the Lounge.
facts.excerpt:
**High Tea - Lounge**

Daily at 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM, or 2:00 PM.

facts.text: The Des Indes Lounge & Restaurant serves lunch, dinner a la carte and a three-course chef's menu.
facts.excerpt: delicious lunch or dinner à la carte or a 3-course menu du Chef at the Des Indes Lounge & Restaurant

facts.text: The chef's dishes are created from premium products of Dutch origin.
facts.excerpt: the delicious dishes that the Chef has created from premium quality products of Dutch origin

facts.text: Chef Wesley Langezaal and his team prepare the hotel's three-course dinner menu.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a divine 3 course diner menu prepared by Chef Wesley Langezaal and his team.

facts.text: Private dining is available for special occasions.
facts.excerpt: For special occasions to be shared with a select company of people.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a large balcony with a view of Lange Voorhout and The Hague skyline.
facts.excerpt: From the large balcony you have a beautiful view of Lange Voorhout and the distinctive The Hague skyline.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a bathroom with a steam cabin and a spacious living room.
facts.excerpt: luxurious bathroom (including steam cabin) and spacious living room

facts.text: Many celebrities and heads of state have stayed in the Presidential Suite.
facts.excerpt: many celebrities and heads of state preceded you

facts.text: Rooms come with Marie Stella Maris care products and a rain shower.
facts.excerpt:
- Marie Stella Maris care products
- Rain shower

facts.text: All rooms and suites are accessible for guests with disabilities, reached by elevator.
facts.excerpt: All our rooms and suites are accessible for guests with disabilities. You can use one of our elevators to reach your accommodation.

facts.text: The concierge helps plan bike routes and arranges rental bikes.
facts.excerpt: Our concierge is ready to help you compile the best bike routes and will make sure your rental bike is ready to go.

facts.text: Hotel Des Indes is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: As a proud member of The Leading Hotels of The World, Hotel Des Indes invites you to join the Leaders Club.

facts.text: The hotel has been associated with the Dutch royal family since it opened in 1881.
facts.excerpt: irrevocably associated with the Dutch royal family since it opened in 1881

facts.text: Junior Suites have large windows with daylight and a view over The Hague.
facts.excerpt: The large windows provide plenty of daylight and offer a nice view over The Hague.

facts.text: The hotel offers event spaces with natural daylight for corporate and private events.
facts.excerpt: Impressive spaces for both corporate and private events, featuring natural daylight in an exclusive and intimate setting.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the restaurant is run by Paris chef Michel Rostang.
facts.excerpt: Run by Paris chef Michel Rostang, the restaurant is excellent

facts.text: Jacques Garcia renovated the hotel, adding a health club with indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: a superb new health club with indoor pool

contradictions.note: Official site names Chef Wesley Langezaal; Conde Nast Traveler (older review) says the restaurant is run by Michel Rostang
